title: Science Fiction Exhibition Opens in Athens
content: © Tristan Fewings / Getty Images“Into the Unknown: A Journey Through Science Fiction” is now on view at the Onassis Cultural Center in Athens."Throughout the exhibition a total of 800 exhibits will be on display, some of which are rare and valuable, such as the Harkonnen Capo chair which was created for the film Dune by Hans Gyger, the original designer of the iconic Alien, and sketches by the artist and special effects pioneer Ray Harryhausen who became widely known for creating the Earth-attacking monster in the 1957 film, '20 Million Miles to Earth'." (Source)The show also includessix original oil paintings from Dinotopia,TheMuseum will host a full slate of classic filmsand other programs associated with the exhibit, which will be up through January 14.-----Breathtaking Sci-Fi Show Opens in AthensInto the Unknown: Barbican Sci-Fi Exhibition Comes to Athens
